title: Make workflow removal reversible
head: Commit containing this receipt; exact published head and normal hook results recorded in the PR description.

dependencies.stack: User-requested F stack on corrected F19. No unmerged D/Q implementation imported.

baseline_review.comparison: Reviewed audit, current main and corrected parent. Main has project-scoped workflow APIs; F20 explicitly scopes its service to the server project. Effect and continuation authority remains unchanged. Final main and parent fetch unchanged. No F20 branch/PR existed at start.
baseline_review.overlap: D21 PR #832 owns management presentation; Q06 PR #806 owns trigger/continuation certification and overlaps manager/flow integration. Resolve and rerun both suites during integration.
baseline_review.parent_ci: All active checks on F19 4d48f498 pass; conditional checks skipped.

figma.visual: Backend contract only. D21 owns the visible controls; no screenshot or live browser binding claimed.

activation.independence: Exact provider and live trigger runtime required. Durable database fences and reconciliation survive flag rollback.

implementation: Transactional tombstone, DISABLED status, generation fence, stable slot and immutable command outcome. Original flow/version/run/effect evidence retained.
30-second server-owned Undo receipt restores the same selected identity and slot paused. Explicit Enable uses canonical readiness and CODE permission gates.
Authenticated no-store complete collection, strict 4096-byte command route and read-only request recovery. Scope/version/revision checks and same-payload idempotency.
SQLite fences cover legacy and concurrent writers. Trigger generation blocks stale callbacks, delayed polls and late ON_ENABLE installation across Remove/Undo/re-enable.
Previously accepted queued/running/paused work continues under existing authority and cancellation. Undo does not queue work or replay effects.
Durable pending trigger reconciliation survives restart and runtime replacement; external unsubscribe remains best effort.

limits.overflow: Explicit refusal; no partial collection or silent eviction.

limitations: Removal does not cancel previously accepted queued/running/paused work or undo external effects. Cancellation and effect authority remain separate.
Local refresh completion does not certify remote unsubscribe; existing trigger manager remote cleanup is best effort.
No hard purge or restore after expiry. Legacy hard delete for workflows never removed is unchanged.
D21 production host adapter, receipt hydration and browser integration remain a release gate. Q06 shared-file integration requires both suites.
No deployment, production activation or F21 implementation. Full repository CI reports separately.
rollback: Unset the flag and restart. Retain schema, draft pins and shared selection view, tombstones, list filtering, SQLite fences and generation checks. A pre-F20 binary must not replace these protections after Remove has been used.

affected.timing: Before final CODE readiness projection correction and transaction indentation; final affected checks cover those changes.

mutations.restoration: Original bytes restored and checked before passing affected tests.

d21_probe.scope: Actual D21 validators; list/remove/request recovery/paused Undo/Enable/rejection. Host adapter not bound.

prior_implementation_verification.manual: Isolated persistent SQLite, second connection and legacy routes; real Worker and trigger manager with local scripted engine, no real provider effects; authenticated panel session over Unix socket.
prior_implementation_verification.guards: Normal commit hooks required before push; exact results recorded in PR description.
prior_implementation_verification.evidence_policy: Committed logs include test verdicts only; raw fixture payloads remain local.

review_fixes.R1: Inventory the authenticated management reader and prove raw trigger inputs, sample data, private metadata and run outputs stay out of its projections.
review_fixes.R2: Reserve one successful Undo outcome per durable receipt outside the ordinary command budget. Receipt consumption and outcome recording are atomic; invalid/reused receipts cannot claim the reservation.
review_fixes.R3: Capture webhook registration identity and generation before body/HMAC awaits. Replaced registrations return 409; callbacks carry the captured generation.
review_fixes.R4: Pin the selected unpublished draft through removal, Undo and late run bookkeeping. Share its selector across reads, readiness/CODE gates and trigger eligibility. Explicit authoring/publication clears the pin.
review_fixes.schema: Additive nullable pinned_draft_id, active-receipt backfill, shared selection view and authoring/publication triggers; old F20 schema upgrade covered.
review_fixes.baseline_reproduction: Six new behavioral regressions plus the existing CI reader-inventory check failed on the reviewed code before fixes.

verification.guards: Normal commit hooks required before push; exact results and published head recorded in the PR description.
verification.evidence_policy: Committed logs include test verdicts only; raw fixture payloads remain local.
verification.ci: Full repository CI reports separately on the pushed head; local affected-suite success is not a full-CI claim.
